positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Integrated software subsystems and simulators in a collaborative team
• Developed automated test scripts for GUI and back-end software integration using python
• Analyze software and system requirements to design test procedures, test cases, and success criteria for rapidly-developing avionics software
• Maintain test documentation & deliverables through Technical Board/Stakeholder Review
• Track multiple layers of Software Requirement Specifications, System Requirements, and Capabilities using IBM Rational DOORS

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed and modified automated test cases in a test automation framework using python and   Linux
•	Performed test sequencing and test execution for automated and semi-automated execution of (embedded) system test cases
•	Implemented code for report generation of Software Test Reports (STR) and Software Test Documents (STD)
•	Supported and performed system integration for automation

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed and tested hardware and software in advance  GPS receivers and navigation systems implemented in Commercial and US Department of Defense (DoD) Military Aircraft 
•	Worked within a multi-contractor team comprised of systems, electrical, and software engineers to troubleshoot and debug software and hardware problems detected during testing. 
•	Successfully completed and met demanding deadlines with multiple individual projects. 
•	Analyzed test results and identified problems with test setup and test procedures for Unit Under Test (UUT). 
•	Developed and implemented code for Airbus CAT II & III prototype using Ada.
•	Supported development of test procedures for multiple projects.
•	Performed Requirements Based Testing (RBT) in accordance with Systems Requirements Specifications (SRS), Interface Requirements Specifications (IRS) and Software Requirements Specifications (SRS).
•	Developed and modified test procedures, test cases, test scripts for GS (Government Systems)  and CS (Commercial Systems) projects using Matlab, DOORS and Python.

GS Projects: JPALS (Joint Precision Approach and Landing System) and ASR 3.7 (Airborne SAASM Receiver)

CS Projects: 4000S, Airbus A350 MMR, GLU 925 or 920, Airbus CAT II & III prototype, KC-46 (Tanker)

positions.title: Doctorate Engineering Co-op
positions.description:
•	Analyzed data to look for trends or process changes and report findings to senior engineer.
•	Supported  environmental  testing such as vibration and temperature for Oscillators
•	Scheduled and participated in system requirements and test procedures reviews

positions.title: Graduate Technical Intern
positions.description:
•	Designed and implemented the use of touch screens in the commercial flight deck environment - focusing on human factors aspects (widget size and placement) as well as investigating which interactive avionics display formats were amenable to touch screen use. 
•	Investigated touch screen technology for future implementation in aircraft flight deck (cockpit) and to determine what advantages and limitations exist in their use? 
•	Successfully develop a functional graphical prototype using an experimental touch screen in a flight deck simulator. 
•	Created the graphical prototype interface with VAPS XT v2.1 and C#.
•	Implemented experimental scenarios with pilot subjects to determine user ability in actual flight environments. In addition, used single and multi touch functions to accomplish tasks such as rotate, zoom, menu selections and etc. with fingers’ gesture, which helped in enhancing the interaction with flight deck interfaces. 
•	Presented final results to senior managers and executive leadership (CEO, etc.) via a formal presentation and exhibit.
